title: Closer to the books. Clearer to play.
summary: A source-linked mechanics review, seven GPT-generated concept sheets, and an implementation checklist. Checked means implemented in the browser source/build workflow; unchecked means planned. Validation evidence is reported separately, and native Unity parity is not implied. Concept images are design targets, not screenshots or exact specifications.

items.title: Move and act in either order
items.detail: One move and one action per crawler; End Turn explicitly advances the party.

items.title: Selected ability descriptions
items.detail: Persistent cost, range, target and effect text, plus a full details dialog for touch and keyboard.

items.title: Complete ability book
items.detail: Expose personal, class, unlocked and equipment actions instead of relying on a few quick slots.

items.title: Exact preview before committing
items.detail: Show HP, Mana, tags and stat-cap changes; cancel spends nothing.

items.title: Enemy movement and declarations
items.detail: Play movement and action events with an enemy-phase banner and original narration.

items.title: Impact layer above sprites
items.detail: Fire, projectiles, reaction effects and floating combat text draw after units and walls.

items.title: Party turn state
items.detail: Separate move used, action used and turn finished; enemy team follows all finished allies.

items.title: Scenario intent before the next round
items.detail: Scenario-specific warnings display the authored threat used by C# execution. A universal intent planner remains planned.

items.title: Area effects and chain reactions
items.detail: Shared resolver must preview all affected cells, friendly fire and bounded spread.

items.title: Potion cooldowns
items.detail: Add readable cooldown/overuse rules with book-grounded terminology and tested balance.

items.title: Katia chooses a form
items.detail: Baseline, Bulwark, Strider and Focused presets with explicit HP/Mana/movement tradeoffs. Tactical adaptations.

items.title: Every crawler has a character sheet
items.detail: Inspect stats, current stance, skills, equipment, party level and XP; Mordecai remains an advisor.

items.title: Three tactical stances
items.detail: Balanced, Defensive and Mobile. These are game rules, not a canonical universal stance system.

items.title: Party levels and skill unlocks
items.detail: Current compact demo reaches levels 1–4 and unlocks personal skills at authored thresholds.

items.title: Equipment changes actual stats
items.detail: Weapon, armor and charm ownership, granted abilities and save persistence.

items.title: All eight characters have directional walking art
items.detail: Four directions with idle and walking frames; base identities retained.

items.title: Distinct form animation sets
items.detail: Author a full directional/attack set per Katia shape, with a mass/silhouette budget. Current form stats do not imply new authored sprites.

items.title: Five stats and allocated points
items.detail: Strength, Intelligence, Constitution, Dexterity and Charisma modify real actions/stats. Three points per level per crawler; safe-room preview/confirm/cancel. Early unlock is an accelerated adaptation.

items.title: Individual skill practice ranks
items.detail: Committed non-item ability uses train that crawler/ability at 3 and 8 uses, granting direct effect bonuses and Mana discounts. Broader training sources and race/gear cap modifiers remain planned.

items.title: Race and class milestone selection
items.detail: Introduce prerequisite previews and save-safe choices at a deliberate campaign stage.

items.title: Katia momentum and engineering
items.detail: Model equipped mass, Rush, bracing and carried platforms; verify timing and costs before authoring.

items.title: Expanded personal kits
items.detail: Carl traps/improvised explosives, Donut spell progression and social abilities, Mongo companion commands; each needs resolver support and source notes.

items.title: Compact original System narration
items.detail: Queue committed actor/action/target and impact messages; dismiss and revisit history.

items.title: NEW ACHIEVEMENT notices
items.detail: Five first-time milestones are saved per run; previews and reloads do not repeatedly award them.

items.title: Protected preparation hub
items.detail: Safe-room Rest, equipment and skills access; actual HP/Mana restoration.

items.title: Objective journal and discoveries
items.detail: Floor progress, encounter door, optional caches/notes and enemy defeats reflect game state.

items.title: Owned boxes and safe-room opening
items.detail: Earn fixed-content achievement and victory boxes; inspect rewards and opened state. Ownership and once-only opening persist; randomized rarity and pet rewards remain planned.

items.title: Safe-room supply recipes
items.detail: Two authored recipes display ingredients/results; shared C# validates and consumes inputs atomically. Portable crafting and specialized workbenches remain planned.

items.title: Audience and sponsor rewards
items.detail: Visible, bounded reward rules tied to achievements and choices; avoid hidden compulsory popularity gates.

items.title: Companion progression
items.detail: Separate Mongo/pet growth, gear and commands from crawler race/class allocation.

items.title: Floor clock and descent pressure
items.detail: Communicate collapse risk and evacuation objectives without punishing time spent in menus.

items.title: Interactive environmental puzzles
items.detail: Levers, doors, destructible supports, traps and discovery descriptions must affect shared state.

items.title: Hoarder: stockpile and Scatterers
items.detail: Capped Scatterer slots, visible emergence warnings, interrupting statuses and action-cost garbage clearing. Ordinary damage also works; mechanics are adaptations.

items.title: Juicer: gym and flaming weight plates
items.detail: Locked throw lanes can be dodged or interrupted; action-cost toppled benches intercept one throw. Original tactical adaptation.

items.title: Ball of Swine: cooperative Speedbump
items.detail: Eight-cell rolling route, three-cell warning, carried parts, a three-part barricade and recoverable helpers. Construction consumes actions; exact rules are adaptations.

items.title: Scenario briefing and adaptation labels
items.detail: Choose a scenario at camp, inspect its objective and invented mechanics, and return to the preserved campaign afterwards.

items.title: Large-unit occupancy and boss phases
items.detail: All current bosses occupy one logical tile. Multi-cell occupancy, a universal phase system and general large-unit collision remain planned.

items.title: Shared tile footprint and anchors
items.detail: Use measured room-kit PNG anchors in both runtime and workshop; one 128×64 logical diamond grid.

items.title: Paint and erase room components
items.detail: Choose an asset and layer, place or erase cells, and rotate components.

items.title: Four camera orientations
items.detail: Rotate the map while preserving world coordinates, picking and screen-relative movement.

items.title: Room recipe import/export
items.detail: Keep visual placements and rotation in a validated JSON authoring recipe.

items.title: Game-compatible tile export
items.detail: Export collision/surface data for authoring or a playable room with visual placements for runtime import.

items.title: Play edited rooms without rebuilding
items.detail: Play this room or import playable JSON. C# validates bounds, assets, layers, actors and connectivity before starting a standalone room; full visual components persist in saves. A valid import replaces the active run.

items.title: Procedural playable campaign
items.detail: Generate connected rooms, objectives, enemy budgets and rewards through the same validated format.

items.title: Full Unity presentation parity
items.detail: Port the browser character sheets, effects, editor and narration UI into native Unity, then run Editor/Web export checks.

art.title: Choose a shape
art.caption: Form selection, character sheets and stance tradeoffs. Illustrative names/bonuses may differ from the tested implementation.

art.title: Grow, equip, prepare
art.caption: Concept treatment for now-playable stat allocation, separate skill practice, owned boxes and crafting. Consult the actual menus for supported numbers and recipes.

art.title: Every action has an answer
art.caption: Selected-ability information, separate move/action budgets, intent, impacts and compact AI feedback. Numbers are mock data.

art.title: Build the room
art.caption: Tile anchors, layers, piece rotation and camera rotation. Use the real exporter schema, not text drawn inside the concept image.

art.title: Hoarder
art.caption: Book 1 scenario concept: stockpile, giant human-ish boss and Scatterer minions. The separate playable scenario adapts this concept; art is not a screenshot or exact specification.
